# Test Fixtures

Store only small, synthetic, and legally reusable test documents here. Never commit a private lease or personal information.

`evaluation/` holds synthetic ranked predictions and an abstention answer used by local metric tests. These files are not CUAD, LegalBench, ContractNLI, or LegalBench-RAG data. Scripted baseline outputs are built in tests from Dataset v1 gold JSON and are never publishable model results.
